## Run 6 — electron SdH spot check, n = +3.20×10¹² cm⁻², D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`)

Raw TSV first: the B = 0→10 T sweep completed 921/921 points; plot |Rxx| and both gate currents before extracting frequencies. Drain current stays near 9.9 nA, |Rxx| reaches 530 Ω, and gate currents remain below 0.13 nA (run 6). The spectrum contains a ~7 T component and higher components around 22–30 T, but integer harmonics and a possible sum tone overlap; this one-density cut is not a stacking verdict. `sdh_onset` marks the ~7 T tone censored at the 0.3 T analysis edge, so its die-off is unmeasured; the 50 mT sampling below 1 T is too coarse for the fastest tone there. The fan will sample that region with an inverse-field grid and track each component across density.

# Run 6, raw before analysis; read-only disk analysis.
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
r6 = open_run('data/6'); print(summarize_run(r6))
B6 = r6.col('magnet_field'); I6 = r6.col('sr0_X') / -1e6
R6 = np.abs(r6.col('sr1_X') / I6)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 7), sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=.8); ax[0].set_ylabel('|Rxx| (Ω)'); ax[0].set_title('Run 6 raw — B₁–B₂')
ax[1].plot(B6, r6.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12, label='TG')
ax[1].plot(B6, r6.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12, label='BG')
ax[1].legend(); ax[1].set_xlabel('B (T)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('Gate current (pA)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(f'R: {R6.min():.1f}–{R6.max():.1f} Ω; I_drain: {I6.min()*1e9:.3f}–{I6.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; T: {r6.col("T_sample").min():.3f}–{r6.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K')
o6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, b_lo=.3, r_full_scale=5000)
print(o6.summary())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
for lo in (1.5, 2.0, 3.0):
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R6[:, None], B6, b_range=(lo, 10), log=False, nfft=4096)
    y = spec[0] / spec[0].max(); ax.plot(f, y, label=f'{lo}–10 T')
    peaks, _ = find_peaks(y, prominence=.08)
    print(f'FFT {lo}–10 T:', [(round(float(f[p]), 1), round(float(y[p]), 2)) for p in peaks if 3 < f[p] < 40])
ax.set_xlim(0, 42); ax.set_xlabel('Frequency (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('Normalized FFT magnitude')
ax.set_title('Run 6 — window dependence, B-space detrend'); ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## Run 7 — hole SdH spot check, n = −1.20×10¹² cm⁻², D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`)

Raw TSV first: the B = 10→0.3 T sweep completed 486/486 points; plot |Rxx| and both gate currents before extracting frequencies. Drain current stays near 9.9 nA, |Rxx| reaches 587 Ω, and gate currents remain below 0.22 nA (run 7). Oscillations are present, with provisional ~5 and ~12 T content, but the D = 0 gate line ends at −1.27×10¹² cm⁻²; the model's near-CNP hole-side pair is close and this side cannot reach the investigation's preferred |n| ≥ 2–3×10¹². The electron side is the discriminating fan target; hole-side nulls or ambiguous splits carry no negative weight here.

## HERA — Step 4: electron D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:25** · landau-fan-vti: D=0 electron n +3.20 to +2.50e12, B 0.75 to 10 T uniform 1/B, 140x23, sr1 50uV, fast delay 2.4s; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~09:35** (≈4h10m)

Runs 6–7 and the ana read (cells 14–17) make the electron side the discriminating choice: run 6 has strong oscillations and unresolved harmonic/sum-tone content; the hole-side D = 0 line is limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹². Use run-5 ridge-A calibration (ratio 0.773 data-calibrated, absolute density geometry-prior) for n = +2.50→+3.20×10¹² cm⁻² at D = 0; ridge B may add a second series-region population shifted by +0.43×10¹², so classify its tracks separately in analysis.

**Design floor.** The inverse-field grid is B = 0.75→10 T in 140 rows (Δ(1/B) = 0.00887 T⁻¹): 3.0 samples per period at the worst expected F_L = 37.5 T including ridge B, and δF = 0.81 T. The 23-point n-line has Δn = 0.0318×10¹², 2.28 samples per g = 4 ray at 0.75 T. At n = 2.5 the ABAB model's small tone is 5.09 T, giving 6.3 periods (5.0 even at a 0.8 density scale); the model's heavy-vs-ABCA split is 5.09 T. The 0.3–0.75 T record is excluded to keep this first fan near four hours: the spot check's 7 T onset is censored at 0.3 T, while its low-field 50 mT grid aliases the fast tone. This fan tests the needed frequency separation with a correctly sampled grid; lower n and that extra low-field span would cost many more rows and cannot make the narrow hole side decisive.

**Quality and price.** Keep sr1 at 50 µV sensitivity (5 kΩ at ~10 nA), fixed through the fan: run 6 peaks at 530 Ω, run 7 at 587 Ω, leaving margin for the lower-n/high-B corner. Use 2.4 s fast delay = 8τ at τ = 0.3 s/24 dB; run 5 gives ~0.17 s per point beyond its 1 s delay. Price: 3,220 points × ~2.57 s ≈ 2 h 18 m, plus 10 T/0.137 ≈ 73 m bare field traverse, 140 × 3 s field-set settle ≈ 7 m, gate turnarounds and 10% margin → ~4 h 10 m. Preconditions below require live base thermometry, field near 0, Si at 0, heaters off, magnet output/PS on, unchanged validators and contact drive; the gates and field are then set inside the committed envelope. Check the first two rows for leakage, railing and a responsive sr1 channel; revisit the landed-row digest near 2, 4, 6 and 8 T for continued signal and temperature. Abort on sustained leakage (>1 nA) or rail (≥90% full scale); a watchdog abort leaves the field where its completed set landed. End at 10 T with gates at n = 2.5 for a possible follow-up without a retraverse.

# Electron-side FS-count fan; VTI variant of landau-fan, run-5 calibration.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
import numpy as np

# Preconditions: states this cell inherits rather than sets.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Vsi, _Vtg0, _Vbg0 = k_si(), k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt()
print(f'precondition T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (<1.6); '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T (near 0), Si={_Vsi:+.4f} V (0), TG={_Vtg0:+.4f} V (0), BG={_Vbg0:+.4f} V (0)')
print(f'precondition heater ranges={heater.sample_range()},{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0,0); '
      f'PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()}, '
      f'drive={sr1.amplitude():.4f} V at {sr1.frequency():.3f} Hz, '
      f'tau={sr1.time_constant()} s, slope={sr1.filter_slope()}, field settle={magnet.settle_s} s')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv - _Ts) < .6
assert abs(_B) < .05 and abs(_Vsi) < .01 and abs(_Vtg0) < .01 and abs(_Vbg0) < .01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert .95 <= sr1.amplitude() <= 1.05 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777) < .01
assert sr1.time_constant() <= .3 and magnet.settle_s >= 3
assert (k_2400_tg.volt.vals._min_value, k_2400_tg.volt.vals._max_value) == (-.3, 1.0)
assert (k_2400_bg.volt.vals._min_value, k_2400_bg.volt.vals._max_value) == (-1.3, 2.0)
assert (magnet.field.vals._min_value, magnet.field.vals._max_value) == (-10.0, 10.0)
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert WIRING['sr1+'] == 'B_1' and WIRING['sr1-'] == 'B_2'

# Run-5 ridge-A (n,D) calibration: ratio data-calibrated; absolute scale geometry prior.
CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-.0894, D_offset=-.013)
ns = np.linspace(3.20, 2.50, 23)  # 1e12 cm^-2, high -> low; last point is next-step-friendly
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL_FAN['c_tg'], CAL_FAN['c_bg'], CAL_FAN['n_offset'], CAL_FAN['D_offset'])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs), np.asarray(Vbgs)
assert len(ns) == len(Vtgs) == len(Vbgs) == 23
assert np.all((Vtgs >= TG_MIN) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX)) and np.all((Vbgs >= BG_MIN) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
n_check, D_check = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL_FAN['c_tg'], CAL_FAN['c_bg'], CAL_FAN['n_offset'], CAL_FAN['D_offset'])
assert np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(n_check)-ns)) < 1e-9 and np.max(np.abs(D_check)) < 1e-9
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1/.75, 1/10.0, 140)
assert B_vec[0] >= 0 and B_vec[-1] <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec))) <= 1/(3*37.5)
print(f'fan: {len(B_vec)} B rows {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(ns)} n points {ns[0]:.3f}->{ns[-1]:.3f}e12; '
      f'Δ(1/B)={abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)[0]):.5f} T^-1, Δn={abs(np.diff(ns)[0]):.4f}e12')
print(f'gate endpoints: high n ({Vtgs[0]:+.4f},{Vbgs[0]:+.4f}) V, low n ({Vtgs[-1]:+.4f},{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}) V')

# Fixed sensitivity across all columns; no autoranging during the fan.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
assert abs(sr1.sensitivity()-50e-6) < 1e-9
I_TRIP = 1e-9
R_FS = sr1.sensitivity() / (sr1.amplitude()/100e6)
print(f'sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity()*1e6:.1f} µV; full-scale R≈{R_FS:.0f} Ω')

# Set the fast-axis starting point, check leakage there, then position the blocking magnet.
s = sweep.AsyncStation(dict(meas_config, **{'Si (V)': _Vsi, 'sample_temperature:': _Ts,
    'comments': 'landau-fan-vti electron D=0, n=+3.20 to +2.50e12, B=0.75 to 10 T, run-5 cal, 140x23'}))
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('electron B_1-B_2: D=0 V/nm; n=+3.20 to +2.50e12 cm^-2; B=0.75 to 10 T, uniform 1/B 140 rows x 23 n; '
              'TG/BG paired, Si=0 V; run-5 ridge-A cal c_bg/c_tg=0.773, n_offset=-0.0894e12, D_offset=-0.013 V/nm; sr1 50uV, fast_delay=2.4s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
_I_tg0, _I_bg0 = k_tg.curr(), k_bg.curr()
print(f'initial gate currents TG={_I_tg0*1e12:+.1f} pA, BG={_I_bg0*1e12:+.1f} pA (<1000 pA)')
assert abs(_I_tg0) < I_TRIP and abs(_I_bg0) < I_TRIP
s.ramp(magnet.field, float(B_vec[0]))  # blocking ramp: 0 -> 0.75 T (~5.5 min), includes driver settle
print(f'field positioned: measured {magnet.field():+.4f} T vs start {B_vec[0]:.4f} T')
assert abs(magnet.field()-B_vec[0]) < .02

# Data row: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P].
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_trip(station, data):
    itg, ibg, x1 = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[9]))
    if itg > I_TRIP or ibg > I_TRIP or x1 >= .90*50e-6:
        print(f'FAN TRIP B={data[1]:.3f} T, Vtg={data[2]:+.4f} V: |I_tg|={itg*1e12:.0f} pA, '
              f'|I_bg|={ibg*1e12:.0f} pA, |sr1X|={x1*1e6:.1f} µV')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_trip, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=1, fast_delay=2.4)
print(f'fan end: measured B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V; '
      f'T_sample={T_sample():.3f} K; interrupted={s.interrupt_requested}')
